'''House Hanarist''' was a [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Noble House]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. [[Cael Hanarist|Cael]] was a famous [[Limmie/Legends|Limmie]] player in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and had a home in [[Crevasse City (Alderaan)/Legends|Crevasse City]] and a [[Cael's fiancée|fiancée]] of another House. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Cael chartered a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] with the last of his family's money to return to the debris site, and then vowed to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Behind the scenes==
House Hanarist was mentioned in Cael's Character Folio included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.
